SELECT H.*,ROWNUM RN FROM( SELECT * FROM ( select h.empid empid, h.chinesename chineseName, hr_get_flevel_deptname(h.deptid) department, get_position_name(h.position_code) position, get_post_grade_name(h.post_grade_code) postGrade, to_char(t.dob,'mm-dd') dob from hr_employee h,hr_personal_info t where h.empid=t.empid and to_char(t.dob,'mm')=to_char(sysdate,'mm') AND (h.date_left IS NULL OR h.date_left >= sysdate)
) ORDER BY $sortname$ $sortorder$ ) H

) ORDER BY $sortname$ $sortorder$ ) H

SELECT H.*,ROWNUM RN FROM( SELECT * FROM ( select c.empid empid, h.chinesename chineseName, hr_get_flevel_deptname(h.deptid) department, get_position_name(h.position_code) position, get_post_grade_name(h.post_grade_code) postGrade, to_char(c.end_contract_date,'yyyy-mm-dd') endContractDate, round(c.end_contract_date-sysdate) days
from hr_employee h,hr_personal_info t, ( select v.empid,(select max(tt.end_contract_date) from hr_contract tt where tt.empid=v.empid) end_contract_date from (select c.empid from hr_contract c group by c.empid ) v) c where c.empid=h.empid and t.empid=c.empid and h.emp_type_code<>'EmpDivision2' and t.nationality_code<>'NationalityCode100' and c.end_contract_date<=add_months(sysdate,2) and (h.date_left is null or h.date_left>sysdate) and h.status_code<>'EmpStatus3' AND not exists (select * from hr_contract v where v.end_contract_date is null and v.empid=h.empid) ) ORDER BY $sortname$ $sortorder$ ) H

SELECT H.*,ROWNUM RN FROM( SELECT * FROM ( select h.empid empid, h.chinesename chineseName, hr_get_flevel_deptname(h.deptid) department, get_position_name(h.position_code) position, get_post_grade_name(h.post_grade_code) postGrade, to_char(h.date_started,'yyyy-mm-dd') joinDate from hr_employee h,hr_personal_info t where h.empid=t.empid and h.emp_type_code<>'EmpDivision2' and t.nationality_code<>'NationalityCode100' and not exists ( select empid from hr_contract t where t.empid=h.empid) and h.status_code<>'EmpStatus3' ) ORDER BY $sortname$ $sortorder$ ) H
